dct_description_sm:
Grid of latitude and longitude lines across Canada – This service is the grid of longitude and latitude lines across Canada that relates points on a map to their true locations on the earth.  
  
  NTS - This service is based on the National Topographic System (NTS). For more details visit http://www.nrcan.gc.ca/earth-sciences/geography/topographic-information/maps/9767  
  
  UTM - This web service is the civilian UTM grid reference used across Canada
dct_title_s: Canada Basemap – Grids (Lat/Long, NTS and UTM)
